structured_output.summary: The draft covers all of B04's done_when with observable, Node-testable criteria. Keeping two cars as startRace's default is forced by existing append-only game tests, which replay a 2-car twin world (tests/game/pause-results.test.ts:58, results-drivers.test.ts:24). Seeded bot line and pace and the N-dot minimap (player dot larger and appended last) already exist, so the work is mostly game.ts wiring. The only problems are minor: a wrong file path and a grid check that could be tighter.

findings.claim: expectedFiles lists `src/start-screen.ts`, which doesn't exist. The start screen is `src/ui/start-screen.ts`, and it doesn't need to change: its RACE button calls `onRace`, which game.ts wires at src/game.ts:130-133. `src/content/drivers.ts` probably doesn't need to change either, because `raceDrivers(6)` already works.
findings.suggestedFix: Builder: pass the car count from game.ts's onRace/restart/onNextRace closures. Leave start-screen.ts and drivers.ts alone unless something genuinely needs them.

findings.claim: AC1 checks that six-car grid slots are on dirt and spread apart, but not that they are clear of props. Today's tests only prove that for 1–4 cars on dust-bowl (tests/content/dust-bowl-tight.test.ts:75). Slots 5–6 sit about 30–37 units behind the line and have never been checked on any track. If one fails, the draft's 'sim grid code stays as is' can't hold.
findings.suggestedFix: Builder: also assert that each six-car slot is more than 3 units clear of every collider, as the existing 1–4 car test does. If a slot fails on some track, change only slots with index ≥ 4 in createWorld (no existing replay or test uses more than 4 cars), and record that in the journal.

findings.claim: AC6 needs the five AI finish ticks to be pairwise distinct on every track for the chosen seed. Two bots finishing on the same tick by chance is possible, and that would make the test flaky by construction.
findings.suggestedFix: Builder: fix one seed per track, check that it gives distinct ticks, and make the test deterministic for that seed. Don't loop over many seeds.

findings.claim: window.__racer.startRace (protected src/driver/index.ts:35-37) calls game.startRace without a car count, so gate races and gate screenshots will still show 2 cars, not what the player sees. This is not special-casing the driver in game code, but the gates won't cover the six-car race.
findings.suggestedFix: No change tonight. The backlog change request asks the owner to let the driver choose the car count.

findings.claim: The play-test is clear. Step 6 says 'RETRY, then NEXT RACE'. RESTART RACE on the pause screen is also covered by AC7 but isn't in the play-test.
findings.suggestedFix: Builder may add 'pause and tap RESTART RACE: still six cars' to the play-test notes.

backlogChangeRequests: Owner: extend the protected driver (src/driver/index.ts) so `startRace` accepts an optional carCount, or switch it to six cars, so the gates' bot laps and race screenshots use the six-car grid players actually see after B04.
